p: Moses: While he was in the door of the tabernacle.
choose: To be the chief priest.
of Aaron was among their rods: Though Joseph's tribe was divided into two in the distribution of the land, yet here it is but one and Levi makes a tribe.
for the house of Levi was: To declare that God chose the house of Levi to serve him in the tabernacle.
murmurings from me: Grudging that Aaron should be high priest.
we die: The Chaldea text describes their complaining in this way; "We die by the sword, the earth swallows us up, the pestilence consumes us."
